text:
Tessa (PM): Quick check on the compact Prompt Sets view: we want regressions to pop in the condensed list, make the CTA language unambiguous (promote vs snapshot vs set baseline), and confirm keyboard/screenreader behavior for the run scrubber. Mock: https://img.redwood.company/ux/compact-promote.png

Lina (Design): In compact mode secondary info is hidden; propose a hover/focus reveal that expands a small metadata panel (model, run id, time). The regression pill needs a stronger affordance 1 as a tiny badge isn't obvious at 1200px density.

Jorge (Frontend): Hover reveal OK, but for keyboard users we must support toggled expand (Enter) rather than hover-only. Virtualized rows mean we should lazy-render the panel. Also propose next/prev hotkeys: 'n' and 'p' for triage nav.

Priya (UX Research): In microtests "promote" performed worse than "set baseline". Participants expect "promote" to be ephemeral. Suggested copy we tested that scored high: "Set current outputs as baseline" with a one-line subtext: "This makes these outputs the reference for future runs. You can revert from baseline history."

Sam (Eng): That wording maps to the backend action. We'll expose a baselineHistoryUrl in the API so the UI can link directly. Also backend can provide a "diffDensity" 0-100 metric to render a tiny sparkline width for quick triage.

a11y-bot: Accessibility scan: regression badge contrast fail in light theme (WCAG AA). Recommend using #0F4A72 on #E6F4FF or add a 2px stroke for separation. For the scrubber: use role="slider", keyboard handled by ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and Home/End, and an aria-live region that announces "Run 5: 2 regressions, high density" when position changes.

Lina (Design): I'll update mock: stronger badge, hover/focus panel, sparkline + numeric density, and modal copy per Priya's tested text. Will also add a subtle left marker for baseline rows.

Jorge (Frontend): Actionable plan: prototype keyboard nav + aria-live in a tiny playground (ETA Tue), implement toggle-expand for keyboard, and wire the hotkeys.

Sam (Eng): Backend: add diffDensity and baselineHistoryUrl (ETA 1 sprint). We'll include a flag for high-contrast mode so UI can switch to numeric fallback.

Tessa (PM): Owners + deadlines:
- Lina: updated compact mock with copy + a11y fixes by Thu EOD.
- Jorge: keyboard prototype and demo link by next Tue.
- Sam: API fields added in sprint; call out any naming concerns now.
- Priya: 4 quick usability checks on the updated mock after Lina posts.

If anyone objects to the copy or hotkeys, drop a note here. Otherwise we'll ship this in the next minor release.
